reuse.why: The change shares fillMonth across spending and average actions and reuses spreadsheet helpers, but copyPreviousMonth bypasses shared category selection and isFixedGroup replaces existing tag extraction.

duplication.why: Average-action duplication is reduced, but category eligibility, note-tag recognition, and expense-sign conversion still have parallel implementations.

placement.why: Budget policy and handler registration stay in their established modules, although generic note-tag recognition belongs in the existing shared tags abstraction.

scope.why: The edits stay focused on the requested month-wide actions, their registration, targeted tests, and release notes.

maintainability.why: The shared filling pipeline is straightforward, but maintainers must still synchronize eligibility rules across SQL selection and copyPreviousMonth's local conditions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: copyPreviousMonth independently applies getFillableCategories policy, and isFixedGroup uses a custom regex instead of shared/tags.ts extractTagsFromText.

disguised_duplication.where: actions.ts expresses hidden/template/fixed-group eligibility through SQL plus filtering in getFillableCategories and through an equivalent rejection condition in copyPreviousMonth.

abstraction_drift.where: includeHiddenCategories is threaded through getFillableCategories, fillMonth, and setFixedMonthAvg, with one conditional SQL fragment; copyPreviousMonth bypasses shared selection, and isFixedGroup reimplements shared tag recognition.
